grammar.title: 起伏
lines: Just as Mrs. Richards was entering the dining room, there was a knock on the front door. Just as 正当、就在 there was a knock 客观存在的敲门声(无灵主语) She knew that it must be the baker . She had told him to come straight in if ever she failed to open the door and to leave the bread on the kitchen table. straight directly; immediately; without delay 直接、不耽搁 If ever = whenever 无论何时 leave v.离开、给...留下 Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid in the small storeroom under the stairs. Mrs. Richards realized that it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the metre . from the Electricity Board 强调从哪儿来的 read v.读取 She tried to explain the situation, saying 'It's only me', but it was too late. 突出“解释” She tried to explain the situation and said 'it's only me'. 并列句相同重要 Trying to explain the situation, she said 'it's only me'. 突出“说”更重要 The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces. let out a cry / scream 大叫一声 When Mrs. Richards walked towards him, he fled , slamming the door behind him. slamming the door behind him “砰”的一声关上门
At the very moment (when) Mrs. Richards was entering the dining room, ... 替换
...,somebody knocked at the front door. someone 太啰嗦
There are more and more people who are interested in English in China. 在中国有越来越多的人对英语感兴趣(啰嗦了，感兴趣的当然是人)

sth. occur to sb. 某人想到某事 It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box .
sth. strike sb. 某人突然想到某事 It suddenly struck me how we could improve the situation.
sth. dawn on sb. 某人明白某事 It suddenly dawned on me that this express was not roaring down the line at ninety miles an hour, but barely chugging along at thirty .
